additional_info.subject: RE: ID0456833-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002732] Log Check CRM:03056000247
additional_info.body:
Dear Manuela,
Thank you for your ticket.
You have reported a session that didn't start on
5:15/5:30 PM (CU time). CU is not a timezone, can you please let us know what timezone are you refering to?
As the charger is in Italy, I took in consideration italy timezone which would be in that case 3:15/3:30pm UTC.
I have checked the charger on that time and there was a session ongoing on the DC2 (CCS cable). An no other session started
Please let me know if the I should check another timestamp or if I should close this ticket.
Thank you!
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Laura Martins,
Please do not change the subject of this email when replying to it.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0456833-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002732] Log Check CRM:03056000247
additional_info.body:
Dear Manuela,
I have checked again and there is no PilotState B detected in the timestamp you have provided.
We can see that during that time there is an ongoing session on one plug but there is nothing showing a new vehicle plugged on the time you have provided.
It is likely that the vehicle didn't plug correctly and the charger never detected it.
I will have to proceed to close this ticket.
Thank you for understanding.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Laura Martins,
Please do not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
